Mailchimp — Marketing API

mailchimp/marketing · version 1

envs add mailchimp/marketing

This declares the keys below in your catalog and sets none of them. A template is a schema for keys; it never carries a value.

Key Needed Kind Notes
MAILCHIMP_API_KEY required secret Account key. The suffix after the dash is the data centre.. Shape ^[a-f0-9]{32}-us\d{1,2}$. where to get it
MAILCHIMP_SERVER_PREFIX required config Data centre prefix, the same suffix the key carries. Routing, not a credential.. Shape ^us\d{1,2}$. where to get it
